energy.sampling_method: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw,utilization.gpu on the guard's poll thread every 5s across the run window under guard; integral = mean_power_W x wall_seconds; idle floor NOT subtracted — receipt reports the whole window the job held the GPU (WSL2 NVML); gpu_seconds fell back to wall seconds (no utilization samples)
energy.derivation: no valid power.draw samples in window (instrument N/A or nvidia-smi unavailable); 0 J booked is NOT an energy claim — run VOIDed by sampling failure

cost.rate_source: host marginal grid rate $0.23/kWh (Alaska residential average, quoted 2026-10-01); gifted compute priced, not billed
